title: Farming Gold... Vegetables, Again
description: Farming Gold... Vegetables, Again — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: QuestGiver_A

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 5 Golded Pumpkins and 15 Golded Ears o' Corn from the golded farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: QuestGiver_A

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Collect 5 Golded Pumpkins and 15 Golded Ears o' Corn from the golded farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

We need the golded veggies as fast as you can get them. iVan's minions are farming them faster then we can get to them and huge golded vegetable lines are forming as a result. If this continues the dungeon will fall into anarchy.

Find the farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and collect the golded vegetables. When you have the required amount return to me, Yakov Smearnov, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Turn-in:

Remarkable work, Dungeon Runner. Care to try it again? There is a King's Coin in it for you.

Objectives:

  • Golded Pumpkins ×5
  • Golded Ears o' Corn ×15

Client level range: 75–77
